subject: The six remaining
author: PhotonKitsune
body:
The six remaining cars.

Collect all Smashes (Carbon GT Concept), Billboards (Carbon Hawker), Jumps (Carbon X12), beat all road-times (Carbon Ikusa GT), beat all Showtime-scores (Carbon Hydros Custom) and complete two sets of Freeburn-Challenges (Carbon Uberschall 8).

___

BP PC gamer. IGN: PhotonKitsune

subject: Platinum finish
author: FeistFan
body:
The platinum finish isn't for getting the Elite license -- it's for getting 100% completion. You have to get every single accomplishment in the in-game accomplishments list, which includes all offline road rules (both speed and showtime) and some very specific items (like a 30x multiplier in a stunt run and a 20x boost chain).

Get to 101% completion and you unlock another car (the only one I'm missing...need to spend a lot more time online than I have so far).

subject: Burnout licence...not elite...
author: Gooner Rhyle
body: The elite licence you'll get after completing the game (all road rules, smashes, etc) and will unlock another finish (platinum) for your cars.

subject: Finishing the rest of the
author: YabobK34
body: Finishing the rest of the stuff will make you Criterion Elite (platinum finish)... but that's not a license.

subject: I guess you are missing the
author: YabobK34
body: I guess you are missing the Carbon Uberschall then. To make it clear for anyone who haven't gotten to 100% yet you get that one as soon as you have done two sets of Freeburn Challenges (2 and 3 players for example.... not Timed and bike ones). Doing that will add an extra 1% to the total, but can be done before you get to 100% (indeed, I think most people got it before they were 100%).
